environment.description: Same Flask application deployed behind Envoy proxy 1.28 sidecar (Istio service mesh) with the envoy.filters.http.header_sanitize extension enabled in the listener filter chain. The Envoy configuration includes a custom Lua filter at the egress path that applies RFC 7230 Section 3.2.6 field-value validation on all downstream response headers, rejecting any response where a header value contains octets outside the visible ASCII range or contains CR (0x0D) or LF (0x0A) characters by replacing the entire response with a 502. pgBouncer 1.21 configured with prepared statement support (server_lifetime=3600, max_prepared_statements=100). The Envoy access log format includes %RESPONSE_FLAGS% for audit. Note: the Lua filter operates post-application at the Envoy egress filter stage, meaning the Flask app generates the malformed response but Envoy intercepts it before it reaches the client.

config.envoy_filter: Lua egress filter enforcing RFC 7230 Section 3.2.6 on response header field-values, blocks CR/LF octets
config.envoy_action: Returns 502 Bad Gateway if any response header value contains 0x0D or 0x0A
